items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: Yeah, we knew Sidney Bishop when he was a kid.

ctx.x: I never got to see that.
You didn't? No. Oh, he had a whole way in quite a few of those. What's this fellow's name in Philadelphia from the Orleans? George something. George Bishop, not Bishop.
George Bakay had been there, but he's dead now too. Oh, is that so?
